title: Glowing candle
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="35%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffe680" stop-opacity="0.8"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#ffaa00" stop-opacity="0.3"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff8800" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="wax" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e8c170"/>
      <stop offset="30%" stop-color="#f5e6a3"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#f5e6a3"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d4a84b"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="waxBottom" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#d4a84b"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b8892e"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow halo -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="35" r="40" fill="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Candle body -->
  <rect x="38" y="52" width="24" height="38" rx="3" fill="url(#wax)"/>
  <!-- Candle bottom shadow -->
  <rect x="38" y="85" width="24" height="5" rx="2" fill="url(#waxBottom)"/>
  <!-- Candle top melted edge -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="12" ry="3" fill="#f5e6a3"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="8" ry="2" fill="#fff8d6"/>

  <!-- Wick -->
  <line x1="50" y1="49" x2="50" y2="43" stroke="#8B6914" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Flame outer -->
  <path d="M50 18 C56 28, 58 34, 50 42 C42 34, 44 28, 50 18 Z" fill="#ff9900"/>
  <!-- Flame middle -->
  <path d="M50 22 C54 30, 55 34, 50 40 C45 34, 46 30, 50 22 Z" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <!-- Flame inner -->
  <path d="M50 28 C52 33, 52 36, 50 39 C48 36, 48 33, 50 28 Z" fill="#fff5cc"/>

  <!-- Candle drips -->
  <path d="M38 55 Q36 60, 37 65 Q38 62, 39 58 Z" fill="#f0d98c"/>
  <path d="M62 54 Q64 60, 63 68 Q62 64, 61 58 Z" fill="#f0d98c"/>

  <!-- Small sparkles -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="25" r="1.5" fill="#ffdd66" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="22" r="1" fill="#ffdd66" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="40" r="1" fill="#ffdd66" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="38" r="1.2" fill="#ffdd66" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
